notes.title: New bonus level
notes.content:
-New fortress bonus level
-Removed previous bonus level, as it wasn't up to content standards in my opinion
-Fixed vehicles in future and paradox level
-Updated the engine and more to improve performance

notes.title: Easy Mode
notes.content: If you have been struggling with the game due to accessibility issues, or you just suck, you can now enable "easy mode" to help you get through tough challenges from the main menu. Have Fun!

1.0.0! All the content for release is in the game and ready to go. Yes things still need to change, and I'm still taking suggestions, but the game is in an acceptable state for release
beta testers will get access soon.
In the mean time, I'll be polishing up the game, fixing bugs and tweaking things
+marketing and PR
Less than a month until release!

notes.title: Run Better Look Better
notes.content:
Latest update (0.9.25) takes advantage of many optimizations. The extra room for performance is used for post processing to make the game pretty :) I tried not to over do it.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35153205/ee443b3f833d693f0e564a9c01723b11aef055a1.png[/img]

notes.title: Performance and Vive Wands
notes.content:
New updates dramatically improve performance. Additionally you can adjust the angle that your hands are at within the main menu. This should make things more comfortable for vive users. 

I hope to test with a WMR headset soon so that I can confirm that the game works on that platform.

notes.title: Loot the cow!
notes.content:
Steam curator, Earth in the Porthole, left an awesome recommendation for the game in Russian. Unfortunatley, google translate seems to have butchered his response.

“Dynamic action from the 1st person for VR with a dynamic and diverse gameplay - you can climb the walls, [b]loot the cows[/b], just sweep away everything in your path with fire power, a la Rambo - great!”

Well now there is a cow worth looting! Hidden in the wild west level inside the general goods store :P

 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35153205/e09ab5fd5b46a518374fe5109707a9ea6234d97a.png[/img]
